data.description:
This VR simulation teaches the essential skill of measuring and recording the weight of ambulatory clients. The tutorial includes preparation, proper technique for using a scale, and documentation.

With multi-language support (English, Spanish, French, and Arabic), this simulator ensures inclusivity and accessibility for a global audience.  

The experience is enhanced by an AI companion, acting as a virtual mentor, to answer questions to reinforce learning.
 
# Key Features: 
- Multi-Language Support: Tailored instructions and narrations in four major languages to cater to diverse learners. 
- AI Companion: An interactive assistant that responds to user queries, and provides clarifications to meet learning needs.(NOTE: Generative AI is still experimental)

 By the end of this tutorial, participants will be able to: 
- Remember the steps and protocols for measuring and recording weight. 
- Understand the importance of accurate weight measurement for patient health and care planning. 
- Apply the correct techniques to measure and record weight safely and accurately. 
- Analyze any factors that may affect weight measurement and take appropriate actions. 
- Evaluate their own technique to ensure it adheres to best practices and safety standards. 
-Create accurate and reliable documentation for patient records.
